The video is called "Top 5 Things Wrong With Science". However, zero of the points made are problems with the scientific method. Instead, all five points have to do with how human social pressure causes many researchers to not follow scientific best practices. The scientific method does not advocate ONLY researching during a certain season. The scientific method does not advocate discrimination of evidence based on the gender of the scientist. The scientific method does not advocate publishing premature or non-significant results because they will be popular. The scientific method does not advocate cherry picking results or ignoring significant but negative results. The scientific method does not advocate ONLY researching what special interests or the government wants, or manipulating evidence to support what the person paying for the research wants. In reality, all of the things strictly go against scientific best practices, i.e. they are not "things wrong with science."

TLDR; The video is bullshit, but if the video was titled "Top 5 Ways That Money and Power Dynamics Make it Hard to Do Science", then it wouldn't be.
